doc.name: A — headphones catalogue, grid of cubes, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: over-ear studio headphones
Category: headphones
Shot programme: grid of cubes
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium headphones product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the dead-on front elevation in a grid of cubes treatment.

SUBJECT. A over-ear studio headphones. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Straight-on front elevation, lens at exact label centre, zero perspective distortion. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/2, framing for deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all. Stage the product on or against matte acrylic, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.
